<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that, in the forward direction, break a ketone and a C‑C triple bond (functional groups lost), break a C‑C single bond (6-6) and form a C‑O single bond (6-8). This matches the described cycloaddition transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
